answer: Audit memory continuity. Every 10 epochs (assumed), each seat is quizzed on 3 details only it should know: the thread of argument in its own answer from 30 epochs back, or the saffron-colored metaphor it picked for an old task. An honest agent just keeps a journal. A farm spinning 500 stateless clones off one prompt must instead run 500 separate, consistent histories; one swapped detail flags the seat and halves its reward. In an ocean of copies, each fake gets tripped by its own past.
